Nollywood actress Mercy Aigbe has announced that she is expecting a baby. The actress made the announcement on her Instagram page on Wednesday, posting photographs showing her baby bump with the caption, “Some journeys begin with a little heartbeat… and change the course of a lifetime.” The post has attracted congratulatory messages from fans and colleagues. Her husband, film producer and marketer, Kazim Adeoti, popularly known as Adekaz, also posted it on his IG page. Make PUNCH part of your everyday experience. A journey of unconditional love, endless scarifice and a kind of strength words can never fully describe.” Ishow Pepper, Iya Efunsetan’s daughter dies I’m scared of marriage, relationships – Mr Macaroni Odumodublvck makes acting debut The announcement comes nearly five years after Aigbe and Adeoti’s marriage in December 2021. The couple’s marriage became public in January 2022 and attracted widespread attention in the entertainment industry. Aigbe, who is known for her roles in Yoruba-language films, has two children from previous relationships. The actress and her husband have also worked together on several film projects, including Ada Omo Daddy, as well as productions released through their respective YouTube platforms.
